original_venue: US equities (QQQ / TQQQ), NYSE cash session open, 2016-02-17 (sic, backtest window 2016-01-01 to 2023-02-17 per CXO summary)

The independent replication explicitly stress-tests execution cost/slippage sensitivity, which is the evidence this mission relies on more heavily than the original paper's no-friction headline figure.)

G1_CONTRACTABLE.reason: Entry (2nd 5-min bar open), stop (1st bar extreme), target (10x risk) are exact. The source's 'about the same' doji threshold is UNKNOWN (not quantified in the available secondary summary); this mission adopted |close-open|<0.10*range as its OWN operational threshold, explicitly flagged as not sourced from the paper.

G2_TICKETABLE.reason: Single discrete MARKET entry, fixed initial SL, single TP (10R), at most one signal per day by construction, 5-minute decision bar (meets the >=5 minute floor exactly).

G3_DATA_VENUE_FIT.GBPUSD/USDJPY/XAUUSD: NOT_ATTEMPTED (external comparator budget limited to one symbol per the internal-first shortcut)

G4_CAUSALITY_WARMUP.causality_reason: Entry fires at the OPEN of the bar immediately after the fully-closed opening bar; no same-bar or future-bar information used.
G4_CAUSALITY_WARMUP.warmup_invariance: PASS (trivial/by construction: each day's opening range uses only that day's own first two M5 bars, zero cross-day state).

G5_TRANSLATION_FIDELITY.reason: Instrument (US equity ETF -> FX spot/CFD), venue (NYSE cash session -> 24-hour FX), 'opening' definition (market open -> AG's own LONDON_NEWYORK window start), and an invented doji threshold. The source paper's reported 33% net annualized alpha (QQQ, 2016-2023) is explicitly NOT inherited as evidence for this candidate; this mission treats OSS_FX_C001's DEV replay as the only evidence that counts for a promotion decision.

ag_reproduced_basis: Deterministic rule-extraction implementation (no external code imported/executed) run against a hashed DEV dataset partition; run_manifest.json in dev_replay/OSS_FX_C001_ORB_NY_OPEN__EURUSD__LONDON_NEWYORK__TRAIN/.
friction_result: FAIL. Gross expectancy is barely positive (+0.045R) and already below the min_profit_factor=1.30 kill threshold (1.058) before any cost. Median per-trade risk distance (~3.5 pips) is small enough that even the BASE 1.4-pip spread scenario alone consumes roughly 0.35-0.41R per trade on average, flipping net expectancy decisively negative (-0.43R base, -0.91R stress). Commission UNKNOWN throughout -- not assumed zero; true result is likely worse, not better.
verdict_reason: Even before this mission's own friction scenario is applied, this AG-operationalized ORB-at-NY-open variant fails the preregistered profit-factor and max-drawdown kill thresholds on 176 real EURUSD DEV trades. Applying the point-in-time VT Markets spread snapshot (friction only, no commission/slippage assumed) turns the already-marginal gross edge decisively negative. This specific 5-minute-ORB formalization on EURUSD at the LONDON_NEWYORK open is rejected for freeze-campaign promotion; this does not evaluate the source paper's own US-equity claim, which this mission never attempted to reproduce.
